briefdescription.para: Compares two strings in reversed order.

detaileddescription.para: Compares only the last "Count" number of characters of Str1Ptr and Str2Ptr.

parameterdescription.para: Base address of the first string.
Base address of the second string.
Number of trailing characters to compare between Str1Ptr and Str2Ptr.

simplesect.para: 0 if the last "Count" bytes match between Str1Ptr and Str2Ptr, otherwise the difference in the unmatched character.

briefdescription.para: Finds the RFDC device name for a given device ID.

detaileddescription.para: Traverses the "/sys/bus/platform/device" directory to find the RFDC device entry that corresponds to the provided device ID. If the entry is found, stores it in the output buffer DevNamePtr.

parameterdescription.para: Base address of the char array where the device name is stored.
ID of the device to look up the RFDC device name entry in "/sys/bus/platform/device".

listitem.para: XRFDC_FAILURE if the device entry is not found for the given device ID.

briefdescription.para: Looks up the device configuration based on the unique device ID.

detaileddescription.para: A table contains the configuration information for each device in the system.

parameterdescription.para: ID of the device to look up the configuration for.

simplesect.para: Pointer to the configuration found, or NULL if the specified device is not found. See xrfdc.h for the definition of XRFdc_Config.

briefdescription.para: Registers and opens the device and maps RFDC to the IO region.

parameterdescription.para: ID of the device to register or map.

briefdescription.para: Implements the static initialization for the XRFdc component.

detaileddescription.para: The implementation of the XRFdc component's static initialization functionality.
